checks.name: Ribbon attributes and topology are finite
Reveal bounds and paired coordinates are stable
Pressure varies and ends are tapered
Width is a geometric footprint rather than line width
Reversed and repeated-point paths stay finite
Degenerate input rejects or returns safe empty geometry
Tip particles expose finite reveal and seed attributes
Ink renderer consumes the shared clock and grade

limitations: SVG XML/viewBox conversion requires browser DOMParser and is not exercised by this Node geometry check.
Shader appearance, GPU compilation, playback timing, resource lifecycle, and device FPS require separate browser evidence.
